<!-- Generated by tools/docgen from doc comments. Do not edit: run scripts/docs.sh. -->

```odin
import sampler "fire:sampler"
```

A sampler: notes play recorded sounds, pitched from a root key.

A `Sample_Map` is the instrument: zones, each a sample (a `stream.Source`
held in memory) with the keys and velocities it answers, its root key,
tuning, gain and optional loop. Build one with `sample_map_create`, then
give it to a sampler node, which plays the notes it receives with a
band-limited resampler per voice, an amp envelope, and per-note tuning,
volume and pan. Zones that match a note together all play (layers).

Each voice also has a filter (lowpass, highpass, bandpass or notch, 12 or
24 dB, with resonance, key and velocity tracking and its own envelope), a
pitch envelope, velocity to pitch and key tracking, and two LFOs (sine,
triangle, saws, square, sample & hold; free, retriggered or synced to the
beat) that reach volume, pan, pitch, cutoff and resonance through a table
of modulation routes. All of it is parameters (see modulation.odin);
`sampler_live` tells a UI what the newest voice is doing, and
`voice_filter_design` gives the filter it would draw.

```odin
zones := []sampler.Sample_Zone{
	{source = piano_c3, root_key = 48, key_hi = 54},
	{source = piano_f3, root_key = 53, key_lo = 55, key_hi = 127},
}
m, _ := sampler.sample_map_create(zones)
node, s := sampler.sampler_create({})
id, _ := graph.add_node(g, node, 0, 2)
graph.connect_events(g, player, id)
sampler.sampler_set_map(s, m)
sampler.sample_map_release(m) // the sampler keeps its own reference
```

Samples must fit in memory: `stream.source_open` loads files up to the
streamer's `ram_bytes` (16 MB decoded by default) into memory; larger
ones play silent here.

## Constants

### MOD_CHUNK

```odin
MOD_CHUNK :: 32
```

Frames between a voice's modulation updates (its filter's coefficients,
its speed, its pan).

### LFOS

```odin
LFOS :: 2
```

LFOs, and modulation routes (a table: each route a source, a destination
and an amount; today's sources are the LFOs).

### MOD_ROUTES

```odin
MOD_ROUTES :: 6
```

Modulation routes.

```odin
SAMPLER_PARAM_VELOCITY : core.Param_Id : core.Param_Id(5)
```

Parameter id of the velocity sensitivity, in percent (0..100, default 40):
0 plays every note as loud; up to 50 the level follows velocity more and
more (50: in proportion); above 50 more than in proportion (the curve
steepens: 100 is velocity cubed). See `velocity_gain`.

```odin
SAMPLER_PARAM_GAIN_DB : core.Param_Id : core.Param_Id(6)
```

Parameter id of the output gain, in dB (−60..12, default 0).

### SAMPLER_PARAM_TRANSPOSE

```odin
SAMPLER_PARAM_TRANSPOSE : core.Param_Id : core.Param_Id(7)
```

Parameter id of a transposition of every note, in semitones (−48..48, default 0).

## Types

### Voice_Filter

```odin
Voice_Filter :: enum u8 {
	Off,
	Lowpass,
	Highpass,
	Bandpass,
	Notch,
}
```

The voice filter's types (SAMPLER_PARAM_FILTER_TYPE).

### Lfo_Shape

```odin
Lfo_Shape :: enum u8 {
	Sine,
	Triangle,
	Saw_Up,
	Saw_Down,
	Square,
	Sample_Hold,
}
```

LFO waveforms (SAMPLER_PARAM_LFO_SHAPE).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Sine` |  |
| `Triangle` |  |
| `Saw_Up` |  |
| `Saw_Down` |  |
| `Square` |  |
| `Sample_Hold` | a new random level each cycle |

### Lfo_Mode

```odin
Lfo_Mode :: enum u8 {
	Auto,
	Trigger,
	Sync,
}
```

How an LFO runs (SAMPLER_PARAM_LFO_MODE).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Auto` | free-running, shared by every voice, at its rate in Hz |
| `Trigger` | each note starts it again, at its rate in Hz |
| `Sync` | locked to the beat, at its synced rate (in beats) |

### Mod_Source

```odin
Mod_Source :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Lfo_1,
	Lfo_2,
}
```

A modulation route's source (SAMPLER_PARAM_ROUTE_SOURCE).

### Mod_Dest

```odin
Mod_Dest :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Volume,
	Pan,
	Pitch,
	Cutoff,
	Resonance,
}
```

What a route modulates (SAMPLER_PARAM_ROUTE_DEST). At ±100%: volume ±100%
(tremolo), pan ±1, pitch ±12 semitones, cutoff ±5 octaves, resonance ±1.

### Sampler_Live

```odin
Sampler_Live :: struct {
	sounding: bool,
	amp: f64,
	filter_env: f64,
	pitch_env: f64,
	cutoff: f64,
	resonance: f64,
	lfo: [2]f64,
	age: int,
}
```

What a sampler is doing now, for a UI: the newest voice's envelopes,
its modulated filter and the LFOs' levels.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `sounding` |  |
| `amp` |  |
| `filter_env` |  |
| `pitch_env` | 0..1 |
| `cutoff` | Hz, with modulation (the setting when nothing sounds) |
| `resonance` | 0..1, with modulation |
| `lfo` | −1..1 |
| `age` | frames since its note-on |

### Sample_Zone

```odin
Sample_Zone :: struct {
	source: ^stream.Source,
	root_key: u8,
	key_lo: u8,
	key_hi: u8,
	exact_keys: bool,
	vel_lo: f32,
	vel_hi: f32,
	tune_cents: f64,
	gain_db: f64,
	start: i64,
	end: i64,
	loop: bool,
	loop_start: i64,
	loop_end: i64,
	one_shot: bool,
	loop_mode: Loop_Mode,
	crossfade: i64,
	reverse: bool,
	pan: f64,
	fade_in: i64,
	fade_out: i64,
}
```

One sample of an instrument and when it plays.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `source` | in memory (the map retains it) |
| `root_key` | the key at which it plays at its own pitch |
| `key_lo` | the keys it answers, inclusive (0 and 0 = every key, unless `exact_keys`) |
| `key_hi` |  |
| `exact_keys` | key_lo..key_hi as given, even 0 and 0 (key 0 alone) |
| `vel_lo` | the velocities it answers, inclusive (0 and 0 = all) |
| `vel_hi` |  |
| `tune_cents` |  |
| `gain_db` |  |
| `start` | first frame played |
| `end` | one past the last; 0 = the end of the file |
| `loop` | loop from `loop_start` to `loop_end` while it sounds |
| `loop_start` |  |
| `loop_end` | 0 = `end` |
| `one_shot` | plays to its end whatever the note-off (drums) |
| `loop_mode` | how a loop repeats |
| `crossfade` | forward loops: frames before the loop end blended into those before the start (0 = a plain jump) |
| `reverse` | plays from the end back to the start (loop points mirrored with it) |
| `pan` | -1 (left) .. 1 (right) |
| `fade_in` | frames from where it starts playing, faded in from silence (0 = none) |
| `fade_out` | frames before where it stops (a zone that doesn't loop), faded out to silence (0 = none) |

### Loop_Mode

```odin
Loop_Mode :: enum u8 {
	Forward,
	Ping_Pong,
}
```

How a zone's loop repeats.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Forward` | jumps back to the loop start |
| `Ping_Pong` | plays the loop forward, then backward, and so on |

### Sample_Map

```odin
Sample_Map :: struct {
	zones: []Sample_Zone,
	refs: int,
	allocator: mem.Allocator,
}
```

An immutable set of zones: the instrument. From `sample_map_create`;
release with `sample_map_release`. Read its zones freely, never change
them (the audio thread reads them).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `zones` |  |
| `refs` | control thread |
| `allocator` |  |

### Sampler_Quality

```odin
Sampler_Quality :: enum u8 {
	Cubic,
	Sinc_Low,
	Sinc_Medium,
	Sinc_High,
}
```

How a sampler voice reads between a sample's frames when it plays it at
another pitch.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Cubic` | 4-point Hermite: cheap; pitched up, some aliasing |
| `Sinc_Low` | band-limited (`dsp.Resampler` at Low): no audible aliasing, about 10× the cost |
| `Sinc_Medium` |  |
| `Sinc_High` |  |

### Sampler_Settings

```odin
Sampler_Settings :: struct {
	voices: int,
	quality: Sampler_Quality,
}
```

Settings for `sampler_create`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `voices` | 0 = 32 |
| `quality` | default Cubic |

### Sampler

```odin
Sampler :: struct {...}
```

A sampler node's state. From `sampler_create`; the node owns it. Procs
not marked [rt] are for the control thread. Fields are internal.

## Procedures

### sampler_lfo_param

```odin
sampler_lfo_param :: proc "contextless"(k: int, first: core.Param_Id) -> core.Param_Id
```

LFO `k`'s parameter `first` is LFO 1's (SAMPLER_PARAM_LFO_SHAPE..PHASE).

### sampler_route_param

```odin
sampler_route_param :: proc "contextless"(r: int, first: core.Param_Id) -> core.Param_Id
```

Route `r`'s parameter `first` is route 1's (SAMPLER_PARAM_ROUTE_SOURCE..AMOUNT).

### voice_filter_design

```odin
voice_filter_design :: proc "contextless"(type: Voice_Filter, steep: bool, cutoff: f64, res: f64, sample_rate: f64) -> (c: [2]dsp.Svf_Coeffs, stages: int)
```

Any thread. The voice filter's two stages for `type`, `steep` (24 dB),
`cutoff` (Hz) and `res` (0..1), and how many are used: what the sampler
runs, and what a UI can draw (with `dsp.svf_response`, multiplying the
stages' gains).

### sampler_live

```odin
sampler_live :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Sampler) -> (l: Sampler_Live)
```

Any thread. What the sampler is doing now (see `Sampler_Live`).

### sample_map_create

```odin
sample_map_create :: proc(zones: []Sample_Zone, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (m: ^Sample_Map, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. Makes a map of `zones` (copied; each source retained),
with one reference held by the caller. `.Invalid_Argument` for a zone
with no source or a range that doesn't fit its file.

### sample_map_retain

```odin
sample_map_retain :: proc(m: ^Sample_Map)
```

Control thread. Adds a reference.

### sample_map_release

```odin
sample_map_release :: proc(m: ^Sample_Map)
```

Control thread. Drops a reference; the last frees the map and releases
its sources.

### sampler_create

```odin
sampler_create :: proc(settings: Sampler_Settings, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (node: core.Node, s: ^Sampler)
```

Control thread. Makes a sampler node (no audio inputs, stereo out; mono
with one output) with no map yet: it is silent until `sampler_set_map`.

### sampler_set_map

```odin
sampler_set_map :: proc(s: ^Sampler, m: ^Sample_Map) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. Plays `m` from the next block (nil: silence). Notes
already sounding finish on the old map, which is released once they
have. The sampler takes its own reference.

### velocity_gain

```odin
velocity_gain :: proc "contextless"(velocity: f64, sens: f64) -> f64
```

The level a note of `velocity` (0..1) plays at, for sensitivity `sens`
(0..1): 1 at 0; up to 0.5 a blend towards `velocity` itself (0.5:
`velocity`); above, `velocity` raised to a power from 1 to 3, so soft
notes are softer still.

### sampler_playhead

```odin
sampler_playhead :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Sampler) -> (frame: i64, playing: bool)
```

Any thread. The sample frame the newest voice still sounding is reading
(for a playhead over its waveform), or false when none sounds.

### register_types

```odin
register_types :: proc(reg: ^core.Node_Registry, streamer: ^stream.Streamer) -> core.Error
```

Registers the sampler, opening sample files through `streamer` (which
must outlive the registry). Control thread.

### write_sample_map

```odin
write_sample_map :: proc(w: ^core.State_Writer, ctx: ^core.Save_Context, m: ^Sample_Map)
```

Writes `m` as a SAMPLE_MAP_TAG chunk: each zone with its file's path (see
`core.write_path`). Nil writes an empty chunk.

### read_sample_map

```odin
read_sample_map :: proc(r: ^core.State_Reader, ctx: ^core.Load_Context, streamer: ^stream.Streamer, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (m: ^Sample_Map, err: core.Error)
```

Reads a map written by `write_sample_map` from the reader's next chunk,
opening each file through `streamer`: a new map with one reference, or
nil for a saved nil map. `.Invalid_Data` for a malformed chunk;
`.Device_Error` if a file cannot be opened; `.Invalid_Argument` if a file
no longer fits its zone.

The synced rates' lengths in beats (SAMPLER_PARAM_LFO_SYNC_RATE indexes it).

Parameter table of the sampler node, as returned by `node_params`. Read-only.
